meta.tagline: 超市里几乎每根香蕉都是同一株植物的复制：一面一模一样的版画墙，一根被网点吃黑的老香蕉，最后一波换色翻出上千种香蕉。

spec.upstream_line: Almost every banana in the shops is one plant, copied: a wall of identical prints, an old banana eaten black by dots, and a wave of colour that turns into many bananas.
